tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour: the logo's people, the wordmark, primary buttons, links, active states. As text on surface or surface-muted (8.7:1).

tokens.name: brand-blue-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand-blue; large dark brand fields.

tokens.name: brand-blue-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind brand-blue text: selected rows, info banners.

tokens.name: brand-teal
tokens.usage: Growth accent: the lead figure in the logo, progress bars, charts, dots. Graphic only; too light for text on white (2.5:1).

tokens.name: teal-text
tokens.usage: Teal when it has to be text or an icon on surface (5.5:1): positive trends, 'approved', 'on track'.

tokens.name: brand-teal-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind teal-text: success badges.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. The logo's home ground.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: App canvas behind cards, table headers.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers, card and input borders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-muted and the soft tints.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, metadata on surface or surface-muted (7.6:1).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand-blue or brand-blue-deep fill (the primary button, the reversed logo).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions; as text on surface. Small use only — never a brand colour.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links: an alias of brand-blue.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending and expiring: 'Chờ duyệt', 'Sắp hết hạn', payroll anomalies. As text or icon on surface (5.0:1) or warning-soft (4.6:1).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind warning text: pending badges, expiring-soon rows.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info banners: an alias of brand-blue-soft, with ink or brand-blue text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Approved, active, on track: an alias of teal-text, used on brand-teal-soft.

tokens.name: heat-bench
tokens.usage: Resource heatmap: allocation load under the bench threshold (default < 50%). Cell text in ink-muted, always with the % figure.

tokens.name: heat-partial
tokens.usage: Resource heatmap: allocation load 50–90%. Cell text in ink.

tokens.name: heat-full
tokens.usage: Resource heatmap: allocation load 90–100%. Cell text in on-brand.

tokens.name: heat-over
tokens.usage: Resource heatmap: allocation load over 100% (overloaded). Cell text in on-brand, plus a warning icon so it never relies on colour alone.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1, the primary series (headcount, payroll cost).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2: orange, distinct from blue for colour-blind readers (5.2:1 on surface).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3: growth or positive series. A darker teal than brand-teal so marks reach 3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4: neutral or comparison series (last year, plan).

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5: light blue. Use at most five series; beyond that, group into 'Khác'. Always label series directly or with a legend.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Inter for every word in the product and in documents: it carries full Vietnamese diacritics.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Quản lý nhân sự, đơn giản hơn

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Nguyễn Thị Hương đã được duyệt nghỉ phép từ 02/10 đến 04/10.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Table cells that lead a row, button labels.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Secondary running text one step under body: table summaries, legends, notes under a table, the text row of a matrix. Field labels use the same size at weight 500.

groups.name: Brand
groups.note: Manrope Medium is the logotype face. Latin only (no Vietnamese tone marks), so it sets the name HRM and short English lines, never interface text.

styles.name: logotype
styles.usage: The company name beside the mark, when the SVG logo cannot be used.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside compact controls, between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows; input padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; logo clear space at 64px mark height.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

radius.note: Rounded, friendly geometry, echoing the round heads and bar tops of the mark.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, badges, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels and the app-icon tile (14 on a 64 grid).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, pills, progress bars.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px white gap, then 2px of brand-blue.
